Bedrijfsomschrijving 

Our client is an established family-owned company with more than 30 years of experience in the food industry, specialized in the production and processing of fresh potato products.

The company combines modern production technology with a strong focus on quality, hygiene and food safety. You will join a professional and dynamic production environment where teamwork, reliability and quality are key.

We are currently looking for an experienced and motivated Line Supervisor to join a production environment in the food industry. You will be responsible for the smooth operation of the production line and will help ensure that production runs safely, efficiently, and according to quality standards.

Your responsibilities:

 
• 
Start up and monitor the production line

 
• 
Coordinate the daily activities on the production line

 
• 
Operate and supervise production equipment

 
• 
Identify and resolve minor operational issues

 
• 
Ensure quality, safety, and hygiene standards are followed

 
• 
Work closely with operators and other production colleagues

 
• 
Operate a forklift when required

 
• 
Previous experience as a production operator; experience as a Line Supervisor / Line Leader is a strong advantage

 
• 
Forklift experience

 
• 
Willingness to work in the food production industry

 
• 
Strong sense of responsibility and ability to take the lead on the production line

 
• 
Very good command of English

 
• 
Willingness to work in a 2-shift system

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team

• Hands-on work with real responsibility

• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market

• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow

Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.

• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.

• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

One of your main tasks will be to investigate complaints, deviations, out-of-specifications (OOS) and non-conformities, draft a report on these and propose corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

You will take on a part of the batch release activities of the medicines and other medical products produced on site. Additionally, you will monitor compliance to the internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and GMP (flows and zoning included) in production and the laboratory.

More specific: 

• Investigation and drafting of report for deviations; OOS; complaints and non-conformitiesMonitor compliance on internal standard operating procedures (SOP’s) and GMP in production and laboratory area
• Final batch release - including review of batch records (1-2h per day)
• GMP/GDP/Pharmacovigilance training of QC and production operators; warehouse workers and drivers.
• Writing of the yearly PQR (Product Quality Review)
• Review of QC and GMP procedures
• Involvement in GMP validation and qualification activities (equipment and processes in production and laboratory area) and other GMP projects
• Management of CAPA’s related to GMP activities
• Management of change controls related to GMP activities
• Support during (preparation of) audits on site
• Perform internal audits at other sites and suppliers

• You have a master degree in Industrial pharmacy
• You have at least 1 or 3 year experience in a GMP environment.
• You are a teamplayer, dynamic and have very good communication skills.
• Your mothertongue is Dutch and are fluent in English and French

Als internationaal familiebedrijf ontwikkelen en co-creëren we - op een vernieuwende, ondernemende en duurzame manier - vloer- en materiaaloplossingen om de woon- en werkkwaliteit van elke generatie te verbeteren. 

B.I.G. heeft zijn hoofdzetel in België, stelt wereldwijd meer dan 4.700 mensen tewerk in 19 landen in Eurazië, Amerika en Oceanië, en bedient klanten in 150 landen. In 2023 boekte B.I.G. een omzet van € 2 miljard. 

Bij B.I.G. werken we doelgericht aan een duurzame toekomst. De combinatie van onze ondernemingszin en ambitie zorgt ervoor dat wij blijven groeien, samen met onze medewerkers, klanten, leveranciers, aandeelhouders en de samenleving om ons heen.

About the role

As Group Marketing Director, you lead Beaulieu's central marketing team. Guided by strategic insights, you act as the group's marketing center of excellence, shaping marketing strategy and supporting divisions in building and executing their growth plans.
In parallel, you oversee the shared marketing services within Beaulieu, including events, graphic design, and digital marketing, ensuring every division benefits from consistent, high-quality execution.
You lead a team of marketing professionals, combining strategic vision with hands-on leadership to translate ideas into impact and ensure that both strategy and execution meet the highest standards.

 

Key responsibilities
 
• You collaborate closely with divisional management and marketeers to develop and execute marketing strategies that drive growth. Acting as a strategic partner, you help identify where marketing can create the greatest impact, align priorities, and turn direction into measurable action. 
• You act as a trusted marketing partner to senior management and division leaders, translating their commercial priorities into marketing action, and representing marketing's voice in group-level decision-making. 
• You lead, coach, and develop the central marketing team, bringing together expertise in CRM, events, graphic design, and digital marketing. You set clear priorities and ensures the team operates as both a center of excellence and a trusted shared services partner to the divisions. 
• Together with divisional marketing teams, you lead the execution of creative, high-impact campaigns across the group, translating strategic priorities into initiatives that deliver results. 
• In close collaboration with divisional marketing and sales teams, you ensure marketing acts as a true commercial growth partner. You provide the insights, tools, and content that help sales engage customers more effectively, while aligning messaging, positioning, and value propositions. 
• You oversee relationships with external partners, including agencies, freelancers, and technology providers, ensuring high-quality delivery and maximizing the value of external expertise across the group. 
• You own the group marketing budget, allocating resources across shared services and divisional needs, and ensuring spend translates into measurable ROI. 
• You lead the group's CRM center of excellence, developing the capabilities, standards, and support needed to maximize the value of Salesforce CRM across the organization. By driving adoption, enabling best practices, and fostering cross-functional collaboration, you ensure CRM is leveraged consistently and effectively across departments. 
• You work closely with the Corporate Communications Director to ensure strong alignment between marketing and communication efforts across the organization. By coordinating branding initiatives, organizational events, and strategic communications, you drive consistency, leverage synergies, and avoid duplication of efforts across the group.  
 

What you bring
 
• At least 10 years of experience in a marketing leadership role. Experience within an international, multi-business organization with a central/decentralized operating model is a plus. 
• Strategic marketing: you know how to segment markets, define positioning, and translate market insights into a marketing strategy and plan aligned with business needs. Proven experience in developing and executing integrated marketing strategies with measurable business impact. 
• Digital marketing: SEO/GEO, paid advertising, email marketing and automation, and digital experience and platforms. Solid understanding of digital marketing, campaign management, and performance analytics. 
• Lead generation: You know how to design and drive campaigns that generate qualified leads and support the sales funnel. 
• You are a trusted partner who operates seamlessly across organizational boundaries. Bridging group and divisional interests, strategic priorities and business execution, and marketing and executive leadership, you create alignment, build commitment, and help the organization move forward with a shared sense of purpose. 
• Excellent communication and presentation skills (in English). 
• Proactive, structured, and results-oriented with a hands-on mentality.

About Specter
 

Specter is a fast-growing IT staffing and consultancy company. Our mission is to make the sector more transparent, fair, and human. We connect IT consultants with suitable projects through open communication and mutual trust.
 

Your role
 

As a Recruitment Consultant, you will:
 
 

•  

Match IT consultants with client projects
  

•  

Build a network within your IT specialization
  

•  

Develop relationships with consultants and clients
  

•  

Guide both parties from the first conversation through the project start
  

•  

Take ownership of your market and working approach
   

Your profile
 
 

•  

You speak English fluently (minimum C1)
  

•  

You are communicative, driven, and eager to learn
  

•  

You are interested in people, business, and technology
  

•  

You enjoy freedom, responsibility, and ambitious targets
  

•  

A bachelor’s or master’s degree is preferred, but motivation and potential matter most
  

•  

Experience in sales or recruitment is an advantage, but not required
   

What we offer
 
 

•  

A close-knit and entrepreneurial team
  

•  

A fixed salary and attractive commission system
  

•  

Extensive training through the Specter Academy
  

•  

Freedom and responsibility to build your own market
  

•  

Growth opportunities toward Managing Partner and shareholder
  

•  

An ambitious culture without a rigid 9-to-5 mentality

What will be your responsibilities?
 
 
 
• Facilitate the incorporation of new clients and commencement of matters. 
 
• Aid in the arrangement and subsequent follow-up of invoicing procedures. 
 
• Supervise the adherence to Know Your Client (KYC) identification protocols. 
 
• Track and ensure compliance with Bar points. 
 
• Handle document archiving, uphold database accuracy, and manage printing responsibilities. 
 
• Deliver comprehensive administrative assistance, encompassing the creation of PowerPoint presentations, coordinating travel logistics, and overseeing timesheet management. 
 
• Effectively organize schedules, arrange appointments with clients and colleagues, and manage logistics for recruitment interviews. 
 
• Serve as a substitute for other administrative assistants when necessary. 

can you recognise yourself in this?
 
 
 
• Demonstrate a proficient command of English and possess a solid passive understanding of either Dutch or French. 
 
• Hold a high school diploma, a bachelor's degree (although not obligatory), or can present equivalent work experience. 
 
• Exhibit a comprehensive understanding of MS Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint). 
 
• Display an inclination for financial and billing systems, expressing a genuine enjoyment of numerical work. 
 
• Showcase robust organizational skills, characterized by a high degree of structure and the ability to effectively prioritize tasks. 
 
• Set yourself apart through precision, accuracy, and a commitment to thoroughness in your work. 
 
• Proactively approach tasks with a customer-centric and service-oriented mindset. 
 
• Flourish in a collaborative team-oriented environment.

We are looking for an Administrative Assistant with over 2 years of experience in administration for our client.
 

What are your tasks?
 
 
 
• Keep agendas up-to-date and ensure consistency amongst Executives’ activities 
 
• Follow-up meetings/conferences/registrations and invitation to meetings/conferences etc. 
 
• Arrange travel plans (flights, hotel reservations etc.). 
 
• Format documents and send e-mail/letters 
 
• Assist with the preparation and the formatting of presentations (PowerPoint) 
 
• Keep our SharePoint up-to-date with meeting materials etc. 
 
• Keep our contact database up to date 
 
• Follow up of contracts with external parties and ensure their appropriate recording in the contract database. 
 
• Collecting and providing all relevant information for internal/external meetings 
 
• Sending outlook invitations and tracking replies 
 
• Gathering working documents, preparing meeting folders and checking presentations’ accuracy 
 
• Organizing Microsoft Teams meetings when relevant 
 
• Ordering lunches 
 
• Setting up meeting rooms for calls and face to face meetings 
 
• Answer phone calls and welcome visitors 

Skills & Competences:
 
 
 
• You possess a degree/diploma/certificate in Administration or relevant 
 
• At least 2 years of experience 
 
• Past experience of working in an international environment is an asset 
 
• Excellent spoken and written in English, dutch and french is a prerequisite 
 
• Excellent computer skills (Word, PowerPoint, Excel...) 
 
• Team worker 
 
• Being proactive 
 
• Good oral and written communication abilities 
 
• Flexible, diplomatic, with good cultural sensitivity o Independent and autonomous 
 
• Eager to learn 
 
• Able to respect deadlines and tight timing

Description
 
 
 
• The assistant will be the first point of contact for callers and visitors and will be responsible for the meeting rooms - taking telephone calls, welcoming visitors, and booking meeting venues. 
 
• The successful candidate will also provide general support to the day-to-day running of the office in Brussels and the organization of various meetings and events.  
 
• He/she will report to the Senior Officer and to the Secretary General of the Association. 
 
• Essential Duties & Responsibilities 
 
• Handle incoming calls and coordinate messages as needed. 
 
• Provide assistance and support to the Senior Officer and Secretary General. 
 
• Day-to-day office management: liaise with suppliers, organize incoming mail and postal services, and maintain office/food supplies and other requirements to keep the office running smoothly including office equipment and office space. 
 
• Administrative and financial work: filing invoices, prepare payments. 
 
• Provide administrative support in booking travel, filing, and updating contacts. 
 
• Provide logistical and administrative support in the organization of internal and external meetings and events. 
 
• Provide ad hoc logistical support to international colleagues for organizing meetings in Brussels. 
 
• Update and manage the website. 
 
• Manage orders of office supplies, courier services, catering, cleaning staff etc.  
 
• Liaise with IT service providers, designers, printers, translators, etc.  
 
• Manage membership fees for members. 
 
• Assist in preparing the annual General Assembly. 
 
• Perform other related duties as required. 
 
• Taking minutes during the Committees and Working Groups meetingsEducation / Experience 
 
• At least three years of relevant experience in administrative support. 
 
• Secretarial studies is an asset. 

Skills Required
 
 
 
• Fluency in French and English - other languages is an asset. 
 
• Excellent communication and organizational skills. 
 
• Excellent computer skills (MS Office, experience with databases, etc.). 
 
• Comfortable in multi-tasking, detail-oriented, and working to deadlines. 
 
• Flexible and adaptable approach to work. 
 
• Basic accounting knowledge. Compensation

jobs.occupation: Power Electronics and Motor Control Engineer
jobs.description:
Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

At Traxial, we are designing the next generation of high-performance, energy-efficient systems. We’re looking for a PE & Motor Control Engineer to join our innovative team and play a pivotal role in creating systems that push boundaries in robotics and industry.
 

This is what you’ll do: 
 
 

•  

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design, develop, and optimize high-efficiency power electronic & motor control systems. 
   
 

•  

Create detailed requirements and functional designs for power electronic circuits & motor controllers.. 
   
 

•  

Perform simulations, testing, and validation to ensure system performance meets all requirements. 
   
 

•  

Troubleshoot and resolve issues during the design, prototyping, and manufacturing phases. 
   
 

•  

Ensure products are compliant with relevant standards for power drive systems. 
   
 

•  

Stay informed about the latest trends and developments in power electronics in robotics & industrial applications. 
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

A Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

Minimum of 3 years of experience in power electronics & circuit design.
   
 

•  

Strong knowledge of inverters and motor controllers.
   
 

•  

Experience with PCB design tools such as Kicad, Altium or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Experience with electronic circuit simulation software such as LTSpice or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Understanding of thermal management and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC).
   
 

•  

Previous experience in model-based design and/or FPGA platforms will be considered a plus.
   
 

•  

A team player with excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.
   
 

•  

Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

The Role: Senior International Pricing Analyst
 

Location: Mechelen, Belgium 
(1-2 days a week on site)
 

 
 

Come make the world and accelerate your success.
 

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.
 

 
 

The Job:
 

 
 

Are you a commercially minded analyst with a passion for pricing, profitability, and turning data into action? We are looking for a Senior International Pricing analyst to help drive profitable growth across our International region.
 

 
 

What You’ll Do:
 
 

• Analyze price/volume/mix, discount and margin performance across the International business to identify risks, margin leakage, discounting behaviour, mix shifts, inflation and corrective opportunities 

• Deliver timely and accurate reporting, dashboards and insights to support pricing governance and business decision-making. 

• Partner with Sales, Finance, Commercial and global teams to evaluate brand and customer profitability, innovation pricing and deal economics. 

• Build financial models and scenario analyses to assess the impact of pricing changes and support strategic recommendations. 

• Actively expand data collection and processing of market-based metrics (consumer prices, competitive positioning 

• Strong contributor for strategic value-based Price List and RRP maintenance, and price architecture 

Who You Are 
 

 
 

We are seeking someone with strong analytical capability, sharp business acumen, and the confidence to influence stakeholders in a dynamic, matrixed environment. If you are curious, detail-oriented, accountable, and motivated by making a measurable business impact, we would love to hear from you:
 

 
 
 

• Candidates must hold a 
relevant degree in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics or a related discipline.  
 

• Experience in pricing, commercial finance, margin management, or business analytics in a leading consumer packaged goods (CPG) company or other companies with strong marketing 

• Advanced proficiency in 
Excel and experience with reporting and visualization tools such as 
Power BI. 

• Fluent in English, additional European language is a plus.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.

• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.

• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.

• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.

• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.

• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.

• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.

• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.

• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 

• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).

• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.

• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.

• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.

• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Are you a real night owl and do you enjoy an active, hands-on job? Then we may have the perfect job for you! We are looking for a motivated Warehouse Operator to join the permanent night shift. You will work for a stable and growing company where you can count on proper training, a great team atmosphere and an attractive salary package. Your responsibilities As a Warehouse Operator, you play an important role in the logistics process. You make sure that goods are processed correctly and that orders are ready for shipment. Your tasks include:
 

 
• Receiving, checking and storing incoming goods
 
• Picking orders using voice picking and/or scanning
 
• Preparing orders accurately and on time for transport
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Moving goods using an electric pallet truck and/or reach truck
 
• Keeping the warehouse clean, organised and safe
 
• Following safety, hygiene and quality procedures (HACCP)
 
• Working in a chilled environment, including a freezer area 

Who are we looking for? You don't need years of experience for this position. Motivation and the right attitude are just as important! We are looking for someone who:
 

 
• Preferably has experience as a warehouse operator, although motivated candidates without experience are also welcome
 
• Works accurately and responsibly
 
• Is not afraid of physical work and enjoys being hands-on
 
• Can work independently as well as in a team
 
• Speaks and understands Dutch and/or English
 
• Has experience with an electric pallet truck or reach truck (a valid certificate is a plus)
 
• Is comfortable working in a cold/freezer environment
 
• Is willing to work the permanent night shift
